A: steady (yellow). B: curious (cyan). C: restless (pink). All settings stay fixed across seeds.
Faint paths: periods 1-10. Bright paths: periods 11-30. Circles/letters: final positions. +z is up.
Late max cell = largest capture-sample share in an 8 x 8 node cell; high share alone does not imply a loop.
Map and stock labels are audit-only. No same-seed repeats: seed effects are not isolated from timing jitter.
